cases.name: Jerren, Corrupted Bishop
cases.text:
Whenever Jerren enters or another nontoken Human you control dies, you lose 2 life and create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
{2}: Target Human you control gains lifelink until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, if you have exactly 13 life, you may pay {4}{B}{B}. If you do, transform Jerren.
